Package com.egradx.auth.web

Class EgradxOrganizationController

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.auth.web.EgradxOrganizationController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/egradx/auth/organizations") public class EgradxOrganizationController extends Object
Administering organizations other than your own — the platform surface.

Two separate checks apply to everything here. Creating, listing and editing organizations requires egradx.organization.*, which EgradxRoleService only ever lets a role in the platform organization hold. The users and roles sub-resources require the ordinary organization-scoped authority plus EgradxAccessGuard.isMemberOf(java.util.UUID), so an organization's own admin can reach exactly its own via these routes and nobody else's — though for that case EgradxMyOrganizationController is the route they actually use, since it saves them having to know their own id.
